summary: KOA reserve form quoted for a 23-ft motorhome (May and July 2027, same prices) and the KOA page, both through the browser driver; Google 4.4/615; RV Life $$$ (avg 49); imagery. Cheapest site $45.32 (water/electric back-in), so it passes the gate; full hookups $50.99-56.66. Year-round, 50 A, 98 ft, pull-throughs, Wi-Fi, pool 5/15-9/8. Waterfront lead: KOA sells 'Next to Ponds waters edge' site types; imagery shows open pads at the pond's north end; no site numbers. Pin fine.
